observation: MetaGPT gives each role (ProductManager, Architect, Engineer) an explicit set of output deliverables, so a phase's work is concrete and auditable rather than implicit.
swarm's lightweight orchestration carries phase/context metadata through function calls and errors, so a failure is traceable to which execution step produced it without hunting through logs.
llama_index's fix-stream discipline requires a regression test that fails on the pre-fix tree and passes on the fix branch, proving a bug was real before a heal/bugfix ticket can merge.
gpt-researcher's costs.py accounts for token/cost spend per run, which hsai adapted into a per-iteration quota ledger with a warn-then-halt per-block budget gate.
ChatDev activates cheaper agents to cut compute under pressure; hsai's budget gate biases model selection one tier cheaper on a soft breach instead of halting the block outright.

ChatDev's session durability survives the transport dying and replays rather than restarts; hsai adapted this into a per-block append-only cycle journal so an interrupted block resumes idempotently instead of re-filing tickets and re-spending quota.

semantic-kernel treats review as a gate distinct from build/test; hsai adapted this into an adversarial cross-model PR review gate where a different-tier model must approve a diff before a PR opens, with a merge gatekeeper enforcing the verdict.

SWE-agent persists a .traj per run and builds a replay/inspector on it - the run record, not just the final patch, is the primary artifact; hsai adapted this into a per-iteration JSON trajectory store with `hsai replay`.
langchain keeps orchestration cleanly separated from tool/provider adapters, which the founding study flagged as worth adopting but no lesson has mined a concrete artifact from yet.
crewAI treats a declarative 'crew' config as the unit of work (mirrors hsai's own core.yaml); the founding study named it but no lesson has mined a concrete artifact from crewAI's repo yet.
JARVIS uses an LLM controller that routes sub-tasks to the right expert model; hsai.models.select is the seed of the same idea but no lesson has mined a concrete artifact from JARVIS yet.
